known_issues: Regression in last build: editing records no longer works; selecting a record shows a blank screen.

existing_features.title: Fix the regression where selecting a pickup record in the Edit/Delete Record flow causes the app to render a blank screen; ensure the dialog transitions to the edit form reliably without throwing any runtime errors.

Harden Edit/Delete Record UI rendering against malformed/empty pickup fields so it cannot crash: add defensive handling for time/date conversions, numeric formatting (e.g., toFixed), and any nullable/optional fields on the selected pickup.

Ensure the Edit/Delete Record actions still work end-to-end after the regression fix: saving an edited pickup updates successfully and returns the user to the pickup list; deleting removes the pickup and returns the user to the pickup list; errors are surfaced in the dialog via existing toast messaging rather than a blank screen.

projectName: Fix blank screen regression when selecting a record to edit/delete
